optimal control of service rate in a stochastic scheduling environment.
the problem of scheduling jobs on a server with a variable service rate.
the design of optimal policies to control service rate and reliability for a single server system.

the optimal rate-reliability trade-off is not a fixed function of the system parameters, but is a dynamic function of the state of the system.
